name: codebase
description: Search code and documentation in repositories by meaning, not exact wording. It splits accessible files into chunks, embeds each one with the same model as memory, and stores them in a private index for that repository. Find settings under Settings → Memory. CodebaseSearch finds relevant code and documentation from a plain-language query. CodebaseReindex refreshes the index incrementally, and CodebaseStatus shows its coverage. It complements literal Search in the files plugin.

configSchema.label: Indexing
configSchema.hint: Which files are indexed and how they are chunked.

configSchema.label: Include globs
configSchema.hint: Enter one pattern per line or separate patterns with commas. Files matching at least one pattern are indexed. Leave the field empty to use common source code and Markdown extensions.

configSchema.label: Exclude globs / dirs
configSchema.hint: Enter folders or patterns to skip. A name without a slash or asterisk is treated as a folder name and skipped anywhere in the project.

configSchema.label: Max file size (bytes)
configSchema.hint: Files larger than this are skipped (also skips likely-minified files with very long lines).

configSchema.label: Chunk size (chars)
configSchema.hint: Maximum length of a chunk before it is split. Splits preferably at a blank line.

configSchema.label: Search & behavior
configSchema.hint: How results are ranked and when the index refreshes.

configSchema.label: Results per search
configSchema.hint: Default number of matches CodebaseSearch returns (the tool's k argument overrides it).

configSchema.label: Relevance floor
configSchema.hint: Minimum cosine similarity for a match to be returned. Raise it for stricter results; lower it if searches come back empty.

configSchema.label: Auto-reindex on search
configSchema.hint: Search automatically refreshes an empty or outdated repository index. Refreshes are combined when several requests arrive close together. You usually won't need to run CodebaseReindex manually.

configSchema.label: Embeddings per refresh
configSchema.hint: Maximum number of chunks embedded in one refresh. Large repositories are split across refreshes to avoid overloading the provider.

configSchema.label: Scheduled re-indexing
configSchema.hint: A background timer that refreshes the index on its own, so a repository bigger than one pass keeps catching up without anyone running CodebaseReindex.

configSchema.label: Re-index on a schedule
configSchema.hint: Off by default. The unattended timer uses the embedding provider and may increase costs. Turn it on only if the scope and interval below suit you.

configSchema.label: Interval (minutes)
configSchema.hint: How often the index refreshes in the background. One run can create at most repositories × passes × embeddings per pass.

configSchema.label: Which repositories
configSchema.hint: Whether the schedule refreshes every repository already present in the index, or only the ones you name.

configSchema.label: Repository paths
configSchema.hint: Enter full paths to repositories, one per line or separated by commas. Paths that do not lead to a readable folder are skipped and logged.

configSchema.label: Passes per repository per tick
configSchema.hint: Maximum number of passes for one repository in a single run. Processing stops sooner if there is nothing left to index.

configSchema.label: Embedding model
configSchema.hint: The embedding model comes from Settings → Memory. It can't be set separately here. After the model changes, the index is rebuilt on the next refresh.
